label: Absolute infinity and infinity in a respect
term: infinite absolutely and in a respect in ST I q.7 a.2
definition: Infinity in a respect is the absence of a limit in some specific way. For example, a form subsisting apart from matter would lack limitation by matter. Absolute infinity excludes the contraction of the act of being itself to a determinate receiving nature. A created form can therefore lack a material bound while having limited esse.
